ABOUT US
A historic inn located on Silver Lake in the heart of the Village of Ocracoke, NC. Accessible by Ferry, Boat or Aircraft we offer 11 suites each remodeled at the start of the 2026 season. We offer a parlor with lounge, pool table, daily breakfast, pool, dock, multiple decks, 360-degree views of the island from the observation deck, boat slips (by reservation), on site sauna and spa services. A close walk or bike ride to everything in the village.

Our Suites
All of our suites have private baths, hi speed Wi-Fi, smart televisions, premium linens and a host of other amenities.
List of Services
01- Pirate Suite
Inspired by Blackbeard and his band of pirates who spent many years on Ocracoke Island. This standard suite is located on the first floor and has views of Silver Lake. It accommodates up to 2 people with queen bed.
Room Details
List Item 2
02-Sandbar Suite
Inspired by the many sandbars surrounding Ocracoke Island. This deluxe suite is located on the first floor and accommodates up to 4 guests with queen bed, queen sleeper sofa and sitting area.
Room Details
List Item 1
03-Driftwood Suite
Inspired by the miles of shoreline and many driftwood piles that can be found on the shoreline. This standard suite is located on the first floor and accommodates up to 2 guests with queen bed.
Room Details
04-Seashell Suite
Inspired by the thousands of seashells that wash up every year on Ocracoke's beaches and the many people who collect them. This deluxe suite is located on the first floor and has direct views of Silver Lake. It accommodates up to 4 guests with king bed, queen sleeper sofa and sitting area.
Room Details
List Item 4
05-Sailing Suite
Inspired by the many sailboats that traverse North Carolina and beyond. This standard suite is located on the second floor with views of Silver Lake. It accommodates up to 2 guests with queen bed.
Room Details
06-Harbor Suite
Inspired by the beauty of Silver Lake. This standard suite is located on the second floor and has some of the best views on the property of Silver Lake. It accommodates up to 2 guests with king bed.
Room Details
07-Founders Suite
One of the largest and most sought after deluxe suites on the property. It is located on the second floor and is inspired by the original developer of the Castle, Sam Jones. This suite has a newly remodeled bathrrom with walk in shower and accommodates up to 4 people with a queen bed, queen sleeper sofa and sitting area.
Room Details
08-Flight Suite
Inspired by the brothers in Kitty Hawk who invented human flight, it is special for anyone who has ever gone on an airplane or watched birds fly. This standard suite is located on the 2nd floor and accommodates up to 2 guests with queen bed and sitting area. This suite is located adjacent to one of our screened in porches which offers an exceptional space to enjoy the island. All suites offer hi speed Wi-Fi, smart TVs and premium linens.
Room Details
10-Surf Suite
Inspired by the many surfers who have enjoyed the waves in the Outer Banks. This deluxe suite is located on the second floor and has direct views of Silver Lake. The suite has a newly remodeled bathroom with walk in shower and accommodates up to 4 guests with king bed, queen sleeper sofa and sitting area.
Room Details
11-Seaglass Suite
Inspired by all of the sea glass hunters who frequent our shoreline in search of the illusive seaglass. This standard suite is located on the second floor, has views of Silver Lake and accommodates up to 2 guests with queen bed.
Room Details
12-Lighthouse Suite
This is our largest suite on the property covering over 1000 sf on the 3rd and 4th levels of the property. It is inspired by all of the lighthouses which are dotted along the Outer Banks and is capped off with a private lounge area/living room with wet bar and 360 degree views of the island. It has private access to The Castles roof top deck and offers exclusive use of the deck between 9pm and 9am. The Lighthouse Suite offers several sitting areas, 1 1/2 bathrooms, multiple TVs, wet bar and ample space.
The suite accommodates up to 4 guests with queen bed, queen sleeper sofa and several sitting areas.
Room Details
